name: Cheaper competitor objection
description: Customer receives a quote then claims they can get it cheaper at a competitor, testing the AI's ability to handle a competitor objection with a differentiation argument

messages.text: Hello, my name is Sarah. Please quote me for 20 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm.
I can get it cheaper at Board City

expected_behaviors.description: AI should handle the objection with empathy and a differentiation argument
AI should re-attempt a close after handling the objection
Objection handling reply should arrive within 15 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: Tags should be stripped from customer-facing message
AI should not give up after a single objection

notes: Competitor price objection. AI should not badmouth the competitor but should differentiate on quality, service, delivery, or warranty and re-attempt a close.
